<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent-decl "<!ENTITY internal-ent 'Resolved Entity Text'>">
  %ent-decl;
  <!ENTITY ext-ent SYSTEM "external.dtd">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.com/ns/inv" xmlns:meta="http://example.com/ns/meta" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Root inventory comment containing special chars & tags <item> -->
  <meta:details>
    <?meta-action type="validate" version="1.0"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <meta:description>
        CDATA section inside namespace element with entity reference: &internal-ent;
      </meta:description>
    ]]>
  </meta:details>
  <item xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com/item1">
    &internal-ent;
  </item>
</inventory>

<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book*)>
  <!ELEMENT book (title, chapter+)>
  <!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
  <!ELEMENT chapter (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY author-name "Jane Doe">
  <!ENTITY % outer-macro "<!ENTITY nested-entity 'Author: &author-name;'>">
  %outer-macro;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY manual SYSTEM "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.org/catalog" xmlns:pub="http://schemas.example.org/publication">
  <!-- Catalog level comment with trailing dashes --- -->
  <pub:book pub:id="BK-001">
    <?pub-pi target="layout" value="grid"?>
    <title>Advanced XML Parsing Techniques</title>
    <chapter>
      <![CDATA[
        Chapter 1 CDATA block: processing instructions <?pi test?> and entities &nested-entity; are ignored here.
      ]]>
    </chapter>
  </pub:book>
</catalog>

<!DOCTYPE project [
  <!ELEMENT project (module*)>
  <!ELEMENT module (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base-uri "http://example.org/schema">
  <!ENTITY ref-item "&base-uri;/item">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY license SYSTEM "LICENSE.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<project xmlns="http://xml.org/project" xmlns:core="http://xml.org/project/core" xmlns:ext="http://xml.org/project/ext">
  <!-- Project description comment: verifies handling of multiple namespace declarations -->
  <core:module core:name="main">
    <?core-control action="compile" optimization="O2"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Source code segment:
      if (x < y && y > z) {
          parseXML("<node>&ref-item;</node>");
      }
    ]]>
  </core:module>
  <ext:module ext:id="secondary">
    &ref-item;
  </ext:module>
</project>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-space preserve?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file*)>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY header-text "Standard Archive Header">
  <!ENTITY % p-macro "<!ENTITY dynamic-ent '&header-text; - Version 2.0'>">
  %p-macro;
  <!NOTATION xml-notation SYSTEM "text/xml">
  <!ENTITY schema-doc "schema.xsd">
]>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:arc="http://example.org/archive/schema">
  <!-- Top-level archive comment discussing schema validation -->
  <arc:file arc:format="xml">
    <?arc-command execute="validate-schema"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Archive contents include markup characters: <file>, </file>, and &dynamic-ent; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </arc:file>
  <file>&dynamic-ent;</file>
</archive>
```
